description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {1}{W}.
Birgi and Spider-Man India trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

uses.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
